nodes.name: Todo dia às 18h
nodes.notes: Ajuste o horário conforme a rotina da profissional.

parameters.name: from
parameters.value: ={{(() => { const sp = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {timeZone: 'America/Sao_Paulo'}).format(new Date(Date.now() + 86400000)); return sp + 'T03:00:00.000Z'; })()}}

parameters.name: to
parameters.value: ={{(() => { const sp = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {timeZone: 'America/Sao_Paulo'}).format(new Date(Date.now() + 86400000)); return new Date(new Date(sp + 'T03:00:00.000Z').getTime() + 86400000 - 1).toISOString(); })()}}
